category: Application Library examples: LiveLink for Simulink
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the LiveLink for Simulink. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: 1D Lithium-Ion Battery Model Charge Control [LiveLink for Simulink example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the LiveLink for Simulink (Tutorials): 1D Lithium-Ion Battery Model Charge Control. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("LiveLink_for_Simulink/Tutorials/li_battery_llsimulink") to solve it, comsol_example_info("li_battery_llsimulink", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > LiveLink for Simulink > Tutorials > li battery llsimulink
tools.notes: Library path LiveLink_for_Simulink/Tutorials/li_battery_llsimulink; model file 4.5 MB. Requires the module licence to open and solve.
